capabilities: Publish the current note or a whole folder to a GitHub repository
Copy the shareable Pages URL to the clipboard
Rewrite wikilinks, callouts, and mermaid blocks for the published site
Upload embedded images to a repo assets folder and fix references
Bootstrap a Jekyll Pages repo and unpublish notes
extras: The personal access token is stored as plain text in the plugin's data.json inside the vault; free GitHub Pages requires a public, world-readable repository; auto-update republishes saved notes with no preview step; the plugin was pending review in the community plugin directory at the time of writing.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish individual notes as a public website served from your own GitHub repository for free.

relations.evidence: Publish Markdown notes from Obsidian to a GitHub repository, serve them through GitHub Pages

summary: Publishes Markdown notes to a GitHub Pages site through the GitHub API and copies a shareable link to the clipboard.
